summary: HUD flag render main. Collects race-flag bytes into a small buffer based on game-state checks, then renders them via sub_553070 with a white color override. Emits yellow (62), blue (65), black (63), pit (102), checkered (66) flags, plus driver-condition flags (130/-126, 68, -116, -115) when the display mode is 2. Skips rendering when dword_7CFEA0 is 0, when a conditional flag is set, when dword_8AB6E4 equals 2, or when this+0x8 (participant slot) is -1. Invoked by sub_4D8450.

local_names.this: participant/hud object whose slot field this+0x8 gates rendering

local_names.v1: return value carrying the last LOW-byte flag/state

operations.description: When dword_7CFEA0 (input display mode) is 0, return immediately with its LOW byte.
Bail out when ConditionalFlagReturn(&dword_5EA43C) is truthy, when dword_8AB6E4 equals 2, or when this+0x8 (participant slot) is not -1 (0xFFFFFFFF).
Initialize the flag buffer index v3 to 0.
When ShortComputation_bad0() is truthy, store yellow flag code 62 as the first buffer entry.
When VehicleFlagCheck() is truthy, append blue flag code 65.
When DisqualificationCheck() is truthy, append black flag code 63.
When PitStateFlagCheck() is truthy, append pit flag code 102.
When dword_7C56A8 (race phase) equals 8, append checkered flag code 66.
When dword_7CFEA0 equals 2, append the driver-condition flags: sub_49B9A0 contributes -126, FuelWeightComputation contributes 68, and sub_49BA30 selects -116 or -115.
When at least one flag was collected (v3 > 0), null-terminate the buffer at index v3.

When dword_8AD394 is non-null, preserve the floats at +92/+96, overwrite both with the constant 1069547520, call FieldSetterAt0x48(0xFFFFFF), render via sub_553070(v9, 10, 0, dword_8B8DC8), then restore the two floats.
Return the last flag-selection value v1; the function is invoked by sub_4D8450.
